stem:
Sunil and his sister measure the same table in handspans and get different numbers.

Why?

options.text: The table changed length between the two tries.
Handspans are not the same size, so the same table can give different counts.
Only the older child can measure length.
Length cannot be measured without a clock.

teacher.key_rationale: Different handspans give different counts for the same table. The table did not have to change.
